categories_thin: Bicycle shops: no independent bike shop found inside the zone (nearest are Planet Bike in East Brunswick and other out-of-zone shops).
Independent hardware stores: none found; the township's hardware demand is served by Home Depot (Monmouth Junction) and chain auto/hardware parts stores, which are excluded.
Toy / hobby / music-instrument retail: only very small or home-based listings (e.g., Parlor Hobbies at a residential address), so almost nothing eligible.
Photography studios: the studios found (Petal Pixel, Digi Video Productions) operate from residential addresses, which I excluded per the no-home-address rule.

Furniture/appliance/flooring retail beyond Route 1: the Route 27 corridor has few showrooms; most furniture retail is on US-1 and much of it is national chains (Bob's, La-Z-Boy, Raymour & Flanigan, Value City) and therefore excluded.
caveats: Chain/franchise exclusions deliberately made: Bright Horizons, KinderCare, The Learning Experience, The Goddard School of Dayton, Kumon (Dayton and Kendall Park), Genie Academy, Board & Brush Creative Studio, Mattress by Appointment, Data Doctors, FASTSIGNSS, Camp Bow Wow, Days Inn, Best Western, Extra Space Storage, Public Storage, Home Depot, and brand car dealers.
Westminster Conservatory of Music (Monmouth Junction) was excluded as a university-run program (Rider University).

Several entries are street-address-only or directory-only (Smokey Cloud, Fine Paints, Middlesex Gutter Supply, Carter Cleaners, Star of David Memorial Chapel); the triage team should confirm they are active and independently owned.
Kingston businesses (Rider Furniture, The New School for Music Study) are inside South Brunswick Township but carry Princeton/Kingston ZIPs; they are roughly 5 miles from central Milltown.
Kendall Park Pet Care Grooming has a Princeton ZIP but sits on Route 27 at the Kendall Park/Franklin edge and markets to Kendall Park.
Phones for some entries were taken from the map listing shown alongside the address; a few are the business's published office line for a firm headquartered elsewhere (e.g., Patriot Transport).
data_gaps: Google Maps, Yelp, YellowPages, BBB, Manta and chamberofcommerce.com all blocked automated access (bot checks/403), and Overpass/OSM API timed out, so coverage relies on Exa's Google-sourced place data plus niche town directories. Some small owner-operated shops on Route 27 and Georges Rd may still be missing.

No reliable list found for warehousing/3PL tenants in the Dayton/Stouts Ln/Herrod Blvd industrial parks; the three logistics entries included are the ones with public pages. Dayton Business Park and 2235 Route 130 lab building are multi-tenant properties whose tenant lists are not public.
Street addresses for Logistics Plus Dayton, East Coast Warehouse Dayton, LTD Nursery and Kalanjali/B2Z dance schools were not published where I could see them.
Self-storage in the zone appears to be all national chains (Extra Space, Public Storage), so nothing eligible was listed under logistics/storage.
